Original horizontal GBA bottom bezel — select. slot. H700 (640x480 only)

Original artwork: "Perfect GBA (no grid)" by mugwomp93.
Author credit and pinned source:
  https://github.com/chrizzo-hb/knulli-bezels/blob/75aa66c41548ebaa95f31d260d47eea2baab9d8a/default-knulli.md
Source image:
  https://github.com/chrizzo-hb/knulli-bezels/blob/75aa66c41548ebaa95f31d260d47eea2baab9d8a/default-knulli/systems/gba-4_3.png
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The existing authored GBA image is resized from 1024x768 to 640x480
using Lanczos filtering for H700 devices with 640x480 panels. The
build checks its alpha mask pixel by pixel against the existing
Slot AGS-102 lower bezel before packaging it. The GBA image is not
redrawn, and the existing AGS-102 asset remains byte-for-byte intact.
Only GBA game screens offer the additional "GBA" bezel. "GBA SP" names
the unchanged existing AGS-102 option; GB/GBC labeling is unchanged.
